svg.title: Cross-section and Wheeler diagram of the same two sequences
svg.desc: Top: thickness-distance cross-section with sequences A and B separated by an unconformity that dies out at x prime; basinward the strata are continuous. Bottom: the same strata in a time-distance Wheeler diagram, with deposition, degradational vacuity and hiatus shown as areas bounded by the upward and downward base-level transit lines and the terminal degradation surface.
